capabilities: record path, size, SHA-256 and mtime of every vault file
detect removed, emptied and rolled-back files at runtime and at startup
group simultaneous changes into one incident alert
restore single files or whole incidents byte for byte, with a copy kept if the target changed
log quiet changes such as renames and your own deletions in an incident log
disambiguation: Not a sync tool itself; it only watches for losses caused by sync tools and other outside changes.
extras: Desktop only (tested on Obsidian 1.14.4 for Linux); the author calls it a safety net, not a backup. Copies live in app storage (IndexedDB), not the vault, with per-file and total size limits; use Clear stored copies before uninstalling.
problem: Sync tools can silently apply an old state from another device, deleting notes or attachments or reverting edits, and the loss may go unnoticed for days.
summary: Data-loss watchdog that records vault files and alerts you once when a sync tool deletes, empties or rolls back notes, then restores them byte for byte.
